cc:Work.dc:title: Binary-task quality
cc:Work.dc:description: Accuracy on four binary tasks, counting every invalid response as incorrect. Points show observed accuracy and horizontal intervals are nominal 95% Wilson intervals. The table gives correct answers over all attempted cases. BoolQ, RTE, and WiC measure agreement with published reference labels; synthetic policy targets come from a deterministic oracle. The intervals are exploratory, do not account for every shared passage or template, and should not be used to infer model differences from overlap alone.
